issues.title: `agentfs init` command fails to create tool_calls table
issues.body:
```
penberg@turing:~/src/tursodatabase/agentfs/agentfs$ cargo run -- init
   Compiling agentfs-sdk v0.1.0 (/home/penberg/src/tursodatabase/agentfs/sdk/rust)
   Compiling agentfs-sandbox v0.1.0 (/home/penberg/src/tursodatabase/agentfs/sandbox)
   Compiling agentfs v0.1.0 (/home/penberg/src/tursodatabase/agentfs/agentfs)
    Finished `dev` profile [unoptimized + debuginfo] target(s) in 3.92s
     Running `target/debug/agentfs init`
Error: Failed to create tool_calls table
```

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves a failure to create the `tool_calls` table, which is likely related to the initialization of a component in the agent system. This aligns with the "Memory initialization issues" sub-category under memory-related issues in the agent issue taxonomy.
